people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.
translations.bsb: And the couriers traveled from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh as far as Zebulun, but the people scorned and mocked them.
translations.kjv: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
translations.asv: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
